detection_logic: Checksum-valid IBAN count with external recipient
purview_implementation: Exchange DLP; IBAN SIT; tiered rules; override with justification
symantec_implementation: Network Prevent for Email; IBAN data identifier; severity-based response rules
limits: Justification at send time not native on Symantec email path (block + release process); archives with passwords not inspected
dependencies: Exchange DLP licence; MTA integration for Symantec
purview_test_status: Detection PASS in S1 simulation (TC-001, TC-002, TC-003a-c); block action not enforced in that mode; TC-010 to TC-012 not run (tenant disabled)

detection_logic: Restricted content upload to personal webmail domains
purview_implementation: Endpoint DLP service domain groups; block with override
symantec_implementation: Endpoint Prevent browser upload with URL list; User Cancel with justification; Network Prevent for Web via proxy as network path
limits: Unsupported browsers; unmanaged devices; HTTPS on network path needs TLS interception
dependencies: Endpoint licence; proxy for Symantec network path

detection_logic: L3/L4 content or 5+ IBANs to non-approved removable media
symantec_implementation: Endpoint Prevent removable storage destination; approved device definition as exception
limits: Unmanaged devices; OS-level device control is a separate control
purview_test_status: Not run (TC-004, TC-005 need a Windows 11 VM and a new tenant)

detection_logic: Sensitive content pasted or uploaded to GenAI domains
purview_implementation: Endpoint DLP paste to browser and upload to cloud domains; DSPM for AI reporting
symantec_implementation: Endpoint Prevent clipboard paste and browser upload with GenAI URL list; Network Prevent for Web
limits: Fast-moving domain list; typed text not inspected; mobile not covered; no DSPM for AI equivalent assumed on Symantec

detection_logic: Restricted files shared externally from SharePoint/OneDrive
symantec_implementation: Network Discover scan of SharePoint targets; Network Protect quarantine
limits: Named gap: Symantec finds the share at the next scan, Purview blocks at share time; exposure window = scan interval + remediation; cloud inline needs a separate CASB product

detection_logic: PAN or payment data in Teams with external participants
limits: Named gap: no Symantec inline control for Teams assumed; to confirm with the current Broadcom cloud offering; also leaves the Teams channel of UC-010 uncovered

detection_logic: Portfolio documents printed on non-approved printers
symantec_implementation: Endpoint Prevent Printer/Fax destination; User Cancel with justification
limits: Virtual printers and screenshots out of scope

detection_logic: Restricted content uploaded to non-sanctioned cloud domains
symantec_implementation: Endpoint Prevent browser upload with URL list; application file access for sync clients
limits: Unsupported browsers; desktop sync clients need application monitoring

detection_logic: Volume anomalies across channels for leavers
purview_implementation: Endpoint DLP aggregation alert; Insider Risk Management
symantec_implementation: Saved incident report or SIEM rule on incident count; UEBA is a separate licence
limits: No native threshold alert equal to Purview aggregation assumed

detection_logic: AML vocabulary near client ID leaving compliance perimeter
purview_implementation: Custom SIT (keyword proximity) + label; restricted alert visibility
symantec_implementation: Keyword list with proximity to Client ID identifier; recipient group conditions; restricted policy group and Enforce role
symantec_coverage: Full (design) for email and print; Teams not covered
limits: Keyword false positives on training material; corpus has no AML-without-client-ID scenario yet
dependencies: MLRO dictionary ownership; compliance group maintained
purview_test_status: Not run (TC-012; no Purview policy covers the AML SIT yet)

detection_logic: Restricted content to domains not on the approved provider list
purview_implementation: Exchange DLP with recipient domain exceptions
symantec_implementation: Network Prevent for Email with recipient conditions (expected)

detection_logic: CID to recipients outside approved perimeter
purview_implementation: EDM on client master + recipient conditions
limits: Jurisdiction of recipient not always inferable from domain

detection_logic: Restricted content to group domains outside documented flows
purview_implementation: Exchange and SharePoint DLP with group domain conditions
symantec_implementation: Network Prevent for Email with recipient conditions (expected)

detection_logic: Credential patterns in messages and uploads
symantec_implementation: Custom data identifiers and regex (expected; partly reused in SY-POL-003-R1)
limits: Secret scanning in code repositories is a separate control
dependencies: Credential pattern coverage per secret type
symantec_test_status: Not designed (GenAI path covered by TC-110)

detection_logic: Investor register or NAV draft sent externally
purview_implementation: EDM on investor register; Exchange DLP
